goal: Choice-Optionen in genau zwei abhaengigen Schritten browserlokal aufbauen. Schritt 1 fuegt ausschliesslich fuer single_choice und multi_choice ein temporaeres options-Array, monotone stabile draft-option-IDs und Add hinzu. Keine Entfernung und kein Reorder vor gruenem Zwischen-Gate. Schritt 2 darf erst danach Remove und deterministisches Reorder im selben Choice-Scope ergaenzen. Keine Persistenz, keine Domain-/Store-Aenderung und keine Default-Auswahl.

guide_delta.summary: I113 startet Auswahloptionen browserlokal. Schritt 1 erlaubt nur das Hinzufuegen nicht-leerer, nicht doppelt vorhandener Optionen mit stabilen monotonen Draft-IDs. Entfernen und Neuordnen bleiben bis zum Zwischen-Gate gesperrt.

direct_dependencies: choice options are valid only for single_choice and multi_choice
persistent MaskFieldSpec already models deterministic option order but remains untouched
Step 2 Remove/Reorder is blocked until Step 1 Add intermediate gate is green
tests_required: Step 1: compile browser shell and focused browser regression
Step 1: new field drafts own browser-local options array; non-fields do not
Step 1: nextDraftOptionId is deterministic and monotone
Step 1: Add exists only for active choice datatypes
Step 1: empty/whitespace option labels are rejected before mutation
Step 1: case-insensitive duplicate labels are rejected before mutation
Step 1: accepted Add appends exactly one object with stable draft-option ID and label
Step 1: option Add does not mutate draft identity, datatype, scalar defaultValue or layout
Step 1: switching datatype never clears or rewrites options
Step 1: visible list and preview preserve insertion order
Step 2 only after green: Remove must not silently break future defaultSelection contract
Step 2 only after green: deterministic Reorder preserves option IDs
GET-only, loopback-only and no-persistence contracts remain unchanged
tests_explicitly_not_run: full suite because only browser mask-builder option draft scope changes
database/repository tests because no persistent path changes
MaskTemplate store tests because no persistence changes
choice write tests because no entry value is written
risks: option identity must not be derived from label or array index
duplicate rejection must happen before mutation
inactive options must not be silently destroyed by datatype changes
Step 1 must not leak into Remove/Reorder or defaultSelection
temporary browser options must not be mistaken for persisted FieldOption IDs
non_changes: no domain FieldType, FieldOption, MaskFieldSpec or ApplicationFieldPlan changes
no database, repository, CatalogService, writer or SQL access
no scalar defaultValue conversion or deletion
expected_side_effects: choice field drafts can accumulate temporary options with stable monotone IDs
option insertion order is visible and deterministic
choice incomplete state can become configured once at least one valid temporary option exists
reload still clears all draft options
